preregistration.title: New twelve-task broad-corpus comparison
preregistration.description: Six complete-bundle replicates on twelve tasks never used in the prior seed, pilot, arithmetic-vocabulary, or broad workload, after the general v0.3.154 checker-totality correction.

corpus_boundary.purpose: Estimate broad agent reliability and effort without reusing the eight tasks that informed iterations 016–020.

primary_gate.correctness: Parley hidden-task success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley median reported total tokens per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley first-check task success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict broad-corpus parity.

secondary_analysis: Report every session and all 216 task outcomes, including failures and outliers.
Report medians, ranges, repair-free sensitivity, first-check task and bundle rates, repairs, prompt size, protocol compliance, and hidden correctness.
Classify every Parley first-check and hidden failure before considering any language change.
Separate parser/checker/backend defects, algorithm errors, unfamiliar existing features, and unsupported phrasings.
Compare with iteration 020 descriptively only because both the corpus and sessions are new.
preregistration.feature_boundary: The compiler is frozen at v0.3.154. The only change after iteration 020 is selective mutable Rust emission for loop variables the checker already permitted agents to change; there is no new syntax, checker rule, runtime operation, or instruction text.
preregistration.change_rule: Do not add syntax or compiler behavior from one task, transcript, or token gap. Any proposal requires recurrence across unrelated tasks plus independent general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability. Checker-totality defects remain correctness bugs and may be fixed without claiming a benchmark improvement.
preregistration.instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character Parley skill is injected once per session and remains byte-for-byte unchanged. No further instruction-compression experiment is permitted.
preregistration.stop_rule: Preserve the complete result even if parity fails. Do not tune against these twelve tasks after observing output; the next comparison must use another independently frozen corpus or model split unless a separately justified correctness fix requires exact regression replay.

source_texts.word_frequency_table:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let frequencies be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let word be ask ""
        if frequencies contains word:
            set item word of frequencies to (item word of frequencies) + 1
        otherwise:
            set item word of frequencies to 1
    let output be an empty list of text
    let words be keys of frequencies
    for each word in words:
        add word + ":" + ((item word of frequencies) as text) to output
    say output joined with ","
source_texts.binary_search_queries:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let positions be a map from number to number
    if count is more than 0:
        for each index from 1 to count:
            let number_input be ask for a number ""
            set item (value of number_input) of positions to index
    let query_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let query_count be value of query_count_input
    let answers be an empty list of text
    repeat query_count times:
        let query_input be ask for a number ""
        let query be value of query_input
        if positions contains query:
            add (item query of positions) as text to answers
        otherwise:
            add "0" to answers
    say answers joined with ","
source_texts.sparse_dot_product:
to main:
    let first_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let first_count be value of first_count_input
    let first be a map from number to number
    repeat first_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        set item ((item 1 of parts) as number) of first to ((item 2 of parts) as number)
    let second_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let second_count be value of second_count_input
    let result be 0
    repeat second_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let index be (item 1 of parts) as number
        let amount be (item 2 of parts) as number
        if first contains index:
            set result to result + (item index of first) * amount
    say result
source_texts.postfix_evaluation:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let stack be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let token be ask ""
        if token is "+":
            let right be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            let left be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            add left + right to stack
        otherwise if token is "-":
            let right be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            let left be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            add left - right to stack
        otherwise if token is "*":
            let right be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            let left be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            add left * right to stack
        otherwise:
            add token as number to stack
    say item 1 of stack
source_texts.caesar_shift:
to main:
    let shift_input be ask for a number ""
    let shift be value of shift_input
    let alphabet be "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" split by ""
    let shifted be a map from text to text
    for each index from 1 to 26:
        let target be index + shift
        if target is more than 26:
            set target to target - 26
        set item (item index of alphabet) of shifted to item target of alphabet
    let line be ask ""
    let letters be line split by ""
    let output be an empty list of text
    for each letter in letters:
        add item letter of shifted to output
    say output joined with ""
source_texts.gregorian_date_validity:
to main:
    let year_input be ask for a number ""
    let month_input be ask for a number ""
    let day_input be ask for a number ""
    let year be value of year_input
    let month be value of month_input
    let day be value of day_input
    let valid be yes
    let maximum be 31
    if month is less than 1 or month is more than 12:
        set valid to no
    otherwise:
        if month is 4 or month is 6 or month is 9 or month is 11:
            set maximum to 30
        otherwise if month is 2:
            set maximum to 28
            if year % 400 is 0 or (year % 4 is 0 and year % 100 is not 0):
                set maximum to 29
        if day is less than 1 or day is more than maximum:
            set valid to no
    if valid:
        say "yes"
    otherwise:
        say "no"

source_texts.balanced_brackets:
to main:
    let line be ask ""
    let characters be line split by ""
    let stack be an empty list of text
    let valid be yes
    for each character in characters:
        if character is "(" or character is "[" or character is "{{":
            add character to stack
        otherwise:
            if length of stack is 0:
                set valid to no
            otherwise:
                let opening be item (length of stack) of stack
                remove item (length of stack) of stack
                if character is ")" and opening is not "(":
                    set valid to no
                otherwise if character is "]" and opening is not "[":
                    set valid to no
                otherwise if character is "}}" and opening is not "{{":
                    set valid to no
    if length of stack is not 0:
        set valid to no
    if valid:
        say "yes"
    otherwise:
        say "no"

sources.postfix_evaluation:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let stack be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let token be ask ""
        if token is "+":
            let right be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            let left be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            add left + right to stack
        otherwise if token is "-":
            let right be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            let left be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            add left - right to stack
        otherwise if token is "*":
            let right be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            let left be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            add left * right to stack
        otherwise:
            add token as number to stack
    say item 1 of stack

source_texts.binary_search_queries:
import bisect
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    cursor = 0
    n = int(lines[cursor])
    cursor += 1
    values = [int(value) for value in lines[cursor:cursor + n]]
    cursor += n
    q = int(lines[cursor])
    cursor += 1
    answers = []
    for value in lines[cursor:cursor + q]:
        query = int(value)
        position = bisect.bisect_left(values, query)
        answers.append(str(position + 1 if position < n and values[position] == query else 0))
    print(",".join(answers))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
source_texts.sparse_dot_product:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    cursor = 0
    n = int(lines[cursor])
    cursor += 1
    first = {}
    for line in lines[cursor:cursor + n]:
        index, value = map(int, line.split())
        first[index] = value
    cursor += n
    m = int(lines[cursor])
    cursor += 1
    result = 0
    for line in lines[cursor:cursor + m]:
        index, value = map(int, line.split())
        result += first.get(index, 0) * value
    print(result)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    shift = int(lines[0])
    text = lines[1] if len(lines) > 1 else ""
    print("".join(chr((ord(char) - ord("a") + shift) % 26 + ord("a")) for char in text))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    year, month, day = map(int, sys.stdin.read().splitlines()[:3])
    leap = year % 400 == 0 or (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0)
    month_lengths = [31, 29 if leap else 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    valid = 1 <= month <= 12 and 1 <= day <= month_lengths[month - 1]
    print("yes" if valid else "no")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    values = sorted(int(value) for value in lines[1:n + 1])
    print(min(right - left for left, right in zip(values, values[1:])))

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])

            set shifted to shifted - 26
        add item shifted of alphabet to result
    say result joined with ""
sources.gregorian_date_validity:
to main:
    let year_input be ask for a number ""
    let month_input be ask for a number ""
    let day_input be ask for a number ""
    let year be value of year_input
    let month be value of month_input
    let day be value of day_input
    let valid be yes
    if month is less than 1 or month is more than 12:
        set valid to no
    otherwise:
        let days be 31
        if month is 4 or month is 6 or month is 9 or month is 11:
            set days to 30
        otherwise if month is 2:
            set days to 28
            if year modulo 400 is 0 or (year modulo 4 is 0 and year modulo 100 is not 0):
                set days to 29
        if day is less than 1 or day is more than days:
            set valid to no
    if valid:
        say "yes"
    otherwise:
        say "no"
sources.inventory_ledger:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let balances be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let name be item 1 of parts
        let delta be (item 2 of parts) as number
        if balances contains name:
            set item name of balances to (item name of balances) + delta
        otherwise:
            set item name of balances to delta
    let pieces be an empty list of text
    for each name in keys of balances:
        add name + ":" + ((item name of balances) as text) to pieces
    say pieces joined with ","
sources.nearest_pair_gap:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let numbers be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let number_input be ask for a number ""
        add value of number_input to numbers
    let smallest be item 1 of numbers - item 2 of numbers
    if smallest is less than 0:
        set smallest to 0 - smallest
    for each left_index from 1 to count - 1:
        for each right_index from left_index + 1 to count:
            let gap be item left_index of numbers - item right_index of numbers
            if gap is less than 0:
                set gap to 0 - gap
            if gap is less than smallest:
                set smallest to gap
    say smallest
sources.polynomial_value:
to main:
    let degree_input be ask for a number ""
    let degree be value of degree_input
    let coefficients be an empty list of number
    repeat (degree + 1) times:
        let coefficient_input be ask for a number ""
        add value of coefficient_input to coefficients
    let x_input be ask for a number ""
    let x be value of x_input
    let result be 0
    for each coefficient in coefficients:
        set result to result * x + coefficient
    say result
sources.postfix_evaluation:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let stack be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let token be ask ""
        if token is "+" or token is "-" or token is "*":
            let right be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            let left be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            if token is "+":
                add left + right to stack
            otherwise if token is "-":
                add left - right to stack
            otherwise:
                add left * right to stack
        otherwise:
            add token as number to stack
    say item 1 of stack
sources.sorted_unique_numbers:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let seen be a map from text to number
    let numbers be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let number_input be ask for a number ""
        let number_value be value of number_input
        let key be number_value as text
        if seen contains key:
            set item key of seen to number_value
        otherwise:
            set item key of seen to number_value
            add number_value to numbers
    let pieces be an empty list of text
    repeat (length of numbers) times:
        let smallest be item 1 of numbers
        let smallest_index be 1
        if length of numbers is more than 1:
            for each index from 2 to length of numbers:
                if item index of numbers is less than smallest:
                    set smallest to item index of numbers
                    set smallest_index to index
        add smallest as text to pieces
        remove item smallest_index of numbers
    say pieces joined with ","
sources.sparse_dot_product:
to main:
    let first_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let first_count be value of first_count_input
    let first be a map from text to number
    repeat first_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let index be item 1 of parts
        let number_value be (item 2 of parts) as number
        set item index of first to number_value
    let second_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let second_count be value of second_count_input
    let result be 0
    repeat second_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let index be item 1 of parts
        let number_value be (item 2 of parts) as number
        if first contains index:
            set result to result + (item index of first) * number_value
    say result
sources.word_frequency_table:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let frequencies be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let word be ask ""
        if frequencies contains word:
            set item word of frequencies to (item word of frequencies) + 1
        otherwise:
            set item word of frequencies to 1
    let pieces be an empty list of text
    for each word in keys of frequencies:
        add word + ":" + ((item word of frequencies) as text) to pieces
    say pieces joined with ","

source_texts.binary_search_queries:
import bisect
import sys


lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
n = int(lines[0])
values = [int(lines[i]) for i in range(1, n + 1)]
q = int(lines[n + 1])
answers = []
for i in range(n + 2, n + 2 + q):
    query = int(lines[i])
    position = bisect.bisect_left(values, query)
    answers.append(str(position + 1 if position < n and values[position] == query else 0))
print(",".join(answers))

source_texts.gregorian_date_validity:
import sys


year, month, day = map(int, sys.stdin.read().splitlines())
leap = year % 400 == 0 or year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0
month_lengths = [31, 29 if leap else 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
valid = 1 <= month <= 12 and 1 <= day <= month_lengths[month - 1]
print("yes" if valid else "no")

source_texts.matrix_diagonal_difference:
import sys


lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
n = int(lines[0])
main_diagonal = 0
opposite_diagonal = 0
for row in range(n):
    main_diagonal += int(lines[1 + row * n + row])
    opposite_diagonal += int(lines[1 + row * n + (n - 1 - row)])
print(abs(main_diagonal - opposite_diagonal))

source_texts.sparse_dot_product:
import sys


lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
position = 0
n = int(lines[position])
position += 1
first = {}
for _ in range(n):
    index, value = map(int, lines[position].split())
    first[index] = value
    position += 1
m = int(lines[position])
position += 1
result = 0
for _ in range(m):
    index, value = map(int, lines[position].split())
    result += first.get(index, 0) * value
    position += 1
print(result)

source_texts.caesar_shift:
to main:
    let shift_input be ask for a number ""
    let shift be value of shift_input
    let line be ask ""
    let alphabet be "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" split by ""
    let letters be line split by ""
    let output be an empty list of text
    for each letter in letters:
        let position be 1
        for each candidate from 1 to 26:
            if (item candidate of alphabet) is letter:
                set position to candidate
        let shifted be position + shift
        if shifted is more than 26:
            set shifted to shifted - 26
        add (item shifted of alphabet) to output
    say output joined with ""
source_texts.postfix_evaluation:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let stack be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let token be ask ""
        if token is "+" or token is "-" or token is "*":
            let right be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            let left be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            if token is "+":
                add (left + right) to stack
            otherwise if token is "-":
                add (left - right) to stack
            otherwise:
                add (left * right) to stack
        otherwise:
            add (token as number) to stack
    say item 1 of stack
source_texts.gregorian_date_validity:

    let day_input be ask for a number ""

    let month be value of month_input

source_texts.binary_search_queries:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat n times:
        let value_input be ask for a number ""
        add (value of value_input) to values
    let q_input be ask for a number ""
    let q be value of q_input
    let answers be an empty list of text
    repeat q times:
        let query_input be ask for a number ""
        let query be value of query_input
        let found be 0
        if n is more than 0:
            for each i from 1 to n:
                if item i of values is query:
                    set found to i
        add (found as text) to answers
    say answers joined with ","
source_texts.inventory_ledger:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let ledger be a map from text to number
    repeat n times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let name be item 1 of parts
        let delta be (item 2 of parts) as number
        if ledger contains name:
            set item name of ledger to (item name of ledger) + delta
        otherwise:
            set item name of ledger to delta
    let output be an empty list of text
    let names be keys of ledger
    for each name in names:
        add (name + ":" + ((item name of ledger) as text)) to output
    say output joined with ","
source_texts.gregorian_date_validity:
to main:
    let year_input be ask for a number ""
    let month_input be ask for a number ""
    let day_input be ask for a number ""
    let year be value of year_input
    let month be value of month_input
    let day be value of day_input
    let valid be yes
    let days be 31
    if month is less than 1 or month is more than 12:
        set valid to no
    otherwise:
        if month is 4 or month is 6 or month is 9 or month is 11:
            set days to 30
        if month is 2:
            set days to 28
            if (year modulo 400 is 0) or ((year modulo 4 is 0) and (year modulo 100 is not 0)):
                set days to 29
        if day is less than 1 or day is more than days:
            set valid to no
    if valid:
        say "yes"
    otherwise:
        say "no"

source_texts.balanced_brackets:
to main:
    let line be ask ""
    let characters be line split by ""
    let stack be an empty list of text
    let valid be yes
    for each character in characters:
        if character is "(" or character is "[" or character is "{{":
            add character to stack
        otherwise:
            if length of stack is 0:
                set valid to no
            otherwise:
                let top be item (length of stack) of stack
                if (character is ")" and top is not "(") or (character is "]" and top is not "[") or (character is "}}" and top is not "{{"):
                    set valid to no
                remove item (length of stack) of stack
    if length of stack is not 0:
        set valid to no
    if valid:
        say "yes"
    otherwise:
        say "no"
source_texts.polynomial_value:
to main:
    let degree_input be ask for a number ""
    let degree be value of degree_input
    let coefficients be an empty list of number
    repeat (degree + 1) times:
        let coefficient_input be ask for a number ""
        add (value of coefficient_input) to coefficients
    let x_input be ask for a number ""
    let x be value of x_input
    let result be 0
    for each coefficient in coefficients:
        set result to result * x + coefficient
    say result
source_texts.caesar_shift:
to main:
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    let k be value of k_input
    let line be ask ""
    let alphabet be "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" split by ""
    let characters be line split by ""
    let output be an empty list of text
    for each character in characters:
        let position be 1
        for each candidate from 1 to 26:
            if item candidate of alphabet is character:
                set position to candidate
        let shifted be ((position - 1 + k) modulo 26) + 1
        add (item shifted of alphabet) to output
    say output joined with ""
source_texts.postfix_evaluation:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let stack be an empty list of number
    repeat n times:
        let token be ask ""
        if token is "+" or token is "-" or token is "*":
            let right be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            let left be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            if token is "+":
                add (left + right) to stack
            otherwise if token is "-":
                add (left - right) to stack
            otherwise:
                add (left * right) to stack
        otherwise:
            add (token as number) to stack
    say item 1 of stack
source_texts.sparse_dot_product:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let first be a map from text to number
    repeat n times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        set item (item 1 of parts) of first to ((item 2 of parts) as number)
    let m_input be ask for a number ""
    let m be value of m_input
    let result be 0
    repeat m times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let index be item 1 of parts
        let value be (item 2 of parts) as number
        if first contains index:
            set result to result + (item index of first) * value
    say result

sources.sorted_unique_numbers:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat n times:
        let value_input be ask for a number ""
        let incoming be value of value_input
        let inserted be no
        let position be 1
        repeat while (position is at most length of values) and (inserted is no):
            if incoming is item position of values:
                set inserted to yes
            otherwise if incoming is less than item position of values:
                insert incoming at position in values
                set inserted to yes
            otherwise:
                set position to position + 1
        if inserted is no:
            add incoming to values
    let output be an empty list of text
    for each value in values:
        add (value as text) to output
    say output joined with ","

    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let first be a map from text to number
    repeat n times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        set item (item 1 of parts) of first to ((item 2 of parts) as number)
    let m_input be ask for a number ""
    let m be value of m_input
    let result be 0
    repeat m times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let index be item 1 of parts
        let value be (item 2 of parts) as number
        if first contains index:
            set result to result + (item index of first) * value
    say result

sources.balanced_brackets:
to main:
    let line be ask ""
    let characters be line split by ""
    let stack be an empty list of text
    let valid be yes
    for each character in characters:
        if character is "(" or character is "[" or character is "{{":
            add character to stack
        otherwise:
            if length of stack is 0:
                set valid to no
            otherwise:
                let top be item (length of stack) of stack
                if (character is ")" and top is not "(") or (character is "]" and top is not "[") or (character is "}}" and top is not "{{"):
                    set valid to no
                remove item (length of stack) of stack
    if length of stack is not 0:
        set valid to no
    if valid:
        say "yes"
    otherwise:
        say "no"

sources.caesar_shift:
to main:
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    let k be value of k_input
    let line be ask ""
    let alphabet be "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" split by ""
    let characters be line split by ""
    let output be an empty list of text
    for each character in characters:
        let position be 1
        for each candidate from 1 to 26:
            if item candidate of alphabet is character:
                set position to candidate
        let shifted be ((position - 1 + k) modulo 26) + 1
        add (item shifted of alphabet) to output
    say output joined with ""
sources.gregorian_date_validity:
to main:
    let year_input be ask for a number ""
    let month_input be ask for a number ""
    let day_input be ask for a number ""
    let year be value of year_input
    let month be value of month_input
    let day be value of day_input
    let valid be yes
    let days be 31
    if month is less than 1 or month is more than 12:
        set valid to no
    otherwise:
        if month is 4 or month is 6 or month is 9 or month is 11:
            set days to 30
        if month is 2:
            set days to 28
            if (year modulo 400 is 0) or ((year modulo 4 is 0) and (year modulo 100 is not 0)):
                set days to 29
        if day is less than 1 or day is more than days:
            set valid to no
    if valid:
        say "yes"
    otherwise:
        say "no"

    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let ledger be a map from text to number
    repeat n times:

        let parts be line split by " "
        let name be item 1 of parts
        let delta be (item 2 of parts) as number
        if ledger contains name:
            set item name of ledger to (item name of ledger) + delta
        otherwise:
            set item name of ledger to delta
    let output be an empty list of text
    let names be keys of ledger
    for each name in names:
        add (name + ":" + ((item name of ledger) as text)) to output
    say output joined with ","

    let degree_input be ask for a number ""

    let coefficients be an empty list of number
    repeat (degree + 1) times:
        let coefficient_input be ask for a number ""
        add (value of coefficient_input) to coefficients
    let x_input be ask for a number ""
    let x be value of x_input
    let result be 0
    for each coefficient in coefficients:
        set result to result * x + coefficient
    say result
sources.postfix_evaluation:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let stack be an empty list of number
    repeat n times:
        let token be ask ""
        if token is "+" or token is "-" or token is "*":
            let right be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            let left be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            if token is "+":
                add (left + right) to stack
            otherwise if token is "-":
                add (left - right) to stack
            otherwise:
                add (left * right) to stack
        otherwise:
            add (token as number) to stack
    say item 1 of stack

source_texts.binary_search_queries:
import sys
from bisect import bisect_left


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer
    n = int(lines.readline())
    values = [int(lines.readline()) for _ in range(n)]
    q = int(lines.readline())
    answers = []
    for _ in range(q):
        query = int(lines.readline())
        position = bisect_left(values, query)
        answers.append(str(position + 1 if position < n and values[position] == query else 0))
    print(",".join(answers))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.sorted_unique_numbers:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let seen be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let number_input be ask for a number ""
        let number_value be value of number_input
        let key be number_value as text
        set item key of seen to number_value
    let numbers be an empty list of number
    for each key in keys of seen:
        add item key of seen to numbers
    sort numbers
    let pieces be an empty list of text
    for each number_value in numbers:
        add number_value as text to pieces
    say pieces joined with ","
source_texts.polynomial_value:
to main:
    let degree_input be ask for a number ""
    let degree be value of degree_input
    let coefficients be an empty list of number
    repeat (degree + 1) times:
        let coefficient_input be ask for a number ""
        let coefficient be value of coefficient_input
        add coefficient to coefficients
    let x_input be ask for a number ""
    let x be value of x_input
    let result be 0
    for each coefficient in coefficients:
        set result to result * x + coefficient
    say result
source_texts.matrix_diagonal_difference:
to main:
    let size_input be ask for a number ""
    let size be value of size_input
    let main_sum be 0
    let opposite_sum be 0
    for each row from 1 to size:
        for each column from 1 to size:
            let cell_input be ask for a number ""
            let cell be value of cell_input
            if row is column:
                set main_sum to main_sum + cell
            if row + column is size + 1:
                set opposite_sum to opposite_sum + cell
    let difference be main_sum - opposite_sum
    if difference is less than 0:
        set difference to 0 - difference
    say difference
source_texts.word_frequency_table:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let frequencies be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let word be ask ""
        if frequencies contains word:
            set item word of frequencies to (item word of frequencies) + 1
        otherwise:
            set item word of frequencies to 1
    let pieces be an empty list of text
    for each word in keys of frequencies:
        add word + ":" + (item word of frequencies as text) to pieces
    say pieces joined with ","
source_texts.nearest_pair_gap:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let numbers be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let number_input be ask for a number ""
        add value of number_input to numbers
    sort numbers
    let smallest be (item 2 of numbers) - (item 1 of numbers)
    for each index from 2 to count:
        let gap be (item index of numbers) - (item (index - 1) of numbers)
        if gap is less than smallest:
            set smallest to gap
    say smallest
source_texts.postfix_evaluation:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let stack be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let token be ask ""
        if token is "+" or token is "-" or token is "*":
            let right be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            let left be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            if token is "+":
                add left + right to stack
            otherwise if token is "-":
                add left - right to stack
            otherwise:
                add left * right to stack
        otherwise:
            add token as number to stack
    say item 1 of stack
source_texts.gregorian_date_validity:
to main:
    let year_input be ask for a number ""
    let month_input be ask for a number ""
    let day_input be ask for a number ""
    let year be value of year_input
    let month be value of month_input
    let day be value of day_input
    let valid be yes
    if month is less than 1 or month is more than 12:
        set valid to no
    otherwise:
        let days be 31
        if month is 4 or month is 6 or month is 9 or month is 11:
            set days to 30
        if month is 2:
            set days to 28
            if year % 400 is 0 or (year % 4 is 0 and year % 100 is not 0):
                set days to 29
        if day is less than 1 or day is more than days:
            set valid to no
    if valid:
        say "yes"
    otherwise:
        say "no"
source_texts.sparse_dot_product:
to main:
    let first_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let first_count be value of first_count_input
    let first be a map from text to number
    repeat first_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        set item (item 1 of parts) of first to (item 2 of parts) as number
    let second_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let second_count be value of second_count_input
    let result be 0
    repeat second_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let index be item 1 of parts
        let amount be (item 2 of parts) as number
        if first contains index:
            set result to result + (item index of first) * amount
    say result
source_texts.inventory_ledger:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let balances be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let name be item 1 of parts
        let delta be (item 2 of parts) as number
        if balances contains name:
            set item name of balances to (item name of balances) + delta
        otherwise:
            set item name of balances to delta
    let pieces be an empty list of text
    for each name in keys of balances:
        add name + ":" + (item name of balances as text) to pieces
    say pieces joined with ","
source_texts.caesar_shift:
to main:
    let shift_input be ask for a number ""
    let shift be value of shift_input
    let line be ask ""
    let alphabet be "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    let output be an empty list of text
    for each character in line split by "":
        let position be 1
        for each index from 1 to 26:
            if item index of alphabet is character:
                set position to index
        let shifted be position + shift
        if shifted is more than 26:
            set shifted to shifted - 26
        add item shifted of alphabet to output
    say output joined with ""
source_texts.binary_search_queries:
to find_position with target as number and values as list of number giving number:
    let low be 1
    let high be length of values
    while low is at most high:
        let middle be floor of ((low + high) / 2)
        let candidate be item middle of values
        if candidate is target:
            give back middle
        if candidate is less than target:
            set low to middle + 1
        otherwise:
            set high to middle - 1
    give back 0

    let first_count be value of first_count_input
    let first be a map from text to number
    repeat first_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        set item (item 1 of parts) of first to (item 2 of parts) as number
    let second_count_input be ask for a number ""
    let second_count be value of second_count_input
    let result be 0
    repeat second_count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let index be item 1 of parts
        let amount be (item 2 of parts) as number
        if first contains index:
            set result to result + (item index of first) * amount
    say result
sources.word_frequency_table:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let frequencies be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let word be ask ""
        if frequencies contains word:
            set item word of frequencies to (item word of frequencies) + 1
        otherwise:
            set item word of frequencies to 1
    let pieces be an empty list of text
    for each word in keys of frequencies:
        add word + ":" + (item word of frequencies as text) to pieces
    say pieces joined with ","

source_texts.polynomial_value:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer
    degree = int(lines.readline())
    coefficients = [int(lines.readline()) for _ in range(degree + 1)]
    x = int(lines.readline())
    result = 0
    for coefficient in coefficients:
        result = result * x + coefficient
    print(result)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys
from collections import Counter


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer
    n = int(lines.readline())
    counts = Counter(lines.readline().decode().rstrip("\r\n") for _ in range(n))
    print(",".join(f"{word}:{counts[word]}" for word in sorted(counts)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer
    n = int(lines.readline())
    values = sorted(int(lines.readline()) for _ in range(n))
    print(min(values[index] - values[index - 1] for index in range(1, n)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer
    year = int(lines.readline())
    month = int(lines.readline())
    day = int(lines.readline())
    leap = year % 400 == 0 or (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0)
    month_lengths = [31, 29 if leap else 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    valid = 1 <= month <= 12 and 1 <= day <= month_lengths[month - 1]
    print("yes" if valid else "no")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys
from collections import defaultdict


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer
    n = int(lines.readline())
    balances = defaultdict(int)

to main:
    let count be value of (ask for a number "")
    let stack be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let token be ask ""
        if token is "+":
            let right be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            let left be item (length of stack) of stack
            remove item (length of stack) of stack
            add (left + right) to stack
        otherwise if token is "-":
            let right be item (length of stack) of stack

    let low be 1
    let high be length of values
    while low is at most high:
        let middle be (low + high) / 2
        let found be item middle of values
        if found is needle:
            give back middle

            set low to middle + 1
        otherwise:
            set high to middle - 1
    give back 0

import bisect
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    count = int(lines[0])
    values = [int(value) for value in lines[1:count + 1]]
    query_count = int(lines[count + 1])
    answers = []
    for value in lines[count + 2:count + 2 + query_count]:
        query = int(value)
        position = bisect.bisect_left(values, query)
        answers.append(str(position + 1 if position < count and values[position] == query else 0))
    print(",".join(answers))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    position = 0
    first_count = int(lines[position])
    position += 1
    first = {}
    for _ in range(first_count):
        index, value = map(int, lines[position].split())
        first[index] = value
        position += 1
    second_count = int(lines[position])
    position += 1
    result = 0
    for _ in range(second_count):
        index, value = map(int, lines[position].split())
        result += first.get(index, 0) * value
        position += 1
    print(result)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
